content:
incident-bot: PAGED: high model RPM on vela14b in us-west (latency increase + 500% over baseline). error rate elevated.

oncall-alex: I'm on it. currently seeing an aggregate RPM spike to ~5k sustained for last 3m; 95th latency up from 120ms -> 800ms. 429s creeping up in the hostpool.

eng-sre-lee: confirming metrics. top callers are a few self-serve customers + one growth customer. Token/sec looks healthy, issue seems scheduling/backpressure + per-model exhaust.

runtime-kat: Proposal: immediate per-model global RPM cap for vela14b and stricter per-key RPM to prevent single-tenant blasts. Also disable function-calling for vela14b to reduce churn on long tail calls.

oncall-alex: Agreed. Suggest global_rpm=600, per_key_rpm=30 soft=false for now. fallback routing to breeze7b for requests exceeding limit.

eng-sre-lee: I'll apply the sculpt. Command I'm about to run: 
```\nPOST /admin/rate-limits
{
  \"model\":\"vela14b\",\n  \"global_rpm\":\"600\",\n  \"per_key_rpm\":\"30\",\n  \"mode\":\"hard\"\n}
```

runtime-kat: Also applying feature gate to disable funcall for vela14b: 
```\nPATCH /config/models/vela14b
{ \"enable_funcall\": false, \"fallback_model\": \"breeze7b\" }
```

eng-sre-lee: Pushed the global RPM change (deploy-id: rl-2026-03-17-01). Logs: \"rate_limit.applied model=vela14b global=600 per_key=30\". Seeing drop in scheduling queue now.

oncall-alex: Saw immediate reduction in 429s from 12% -> 3% in last 2m. 95th latency down to ~280ms. Customer-facing errors still for some users (those who were mid-request when cutover).

support-jamie: Opening status update: \"We are mitigating elevated errors impacting calls to vela14b; applying traffic shaping and fallback to smaller models. Investigating root cause and will update.\" Notifying top 5 affected customers (DMs + support tickets).

product-sam: Any functional degradation expected for customers moved to breeze7b? We should mention potential prompt truncation or differing outputs in the status note.

runtime-kat: Yes mention output variance and that funcall is disabled for vela14b during mitigation. Recommend telling customers to pin model or opt-into dedicated capacity if they need exact parity.

oncall-alex: Adding short-term guard: enable quick-rollover fallback rule so traffic over limit goes to breeze7b with x-limited-tokens header. Rule snippet: 
```\nif model==vela14b and key_rpm_exceeded then route -> breeze7b set header X-Rate-Fallback: vela->breeze
```

eng-sre-lee: Monitoring dashboard shows traffic redistributed cleanly. Error budget for hostpool dropping back into healthy range. Keeping the hard cap in place for 30m and re-evaluating.

support-jamie: Customer notes: two enterprise customers reported 429s during heavy batch jobs. Both have active support threads (INC-4833, INC-4834). Copying product and account teams.

oncall-alex: Moving to handoff in 20m. If anything regresses ping @oncall-maria. Current mitigation: global_rpm=600 per_key=30 funcall disabled fallback=breeze7b.

oncall-maria: I'll take over at 02:20 UTC. Will keep monitoring and coordinate with infra if we need capacity bursts or to carve out dedicated pools.

product-sam: Postmortem checklist: capture customer impact window, why vela14b traffic spiked (query customer patterns), evaluate autoscale thresholds and rate-limiter defaults, consider a default funcall throttle.

oncall-alex: Thanks team. I'll leave notes in the incident ticket and attach the config diffs. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident annotated: incident_id=INC-2026-03-17-vela14b-rpm. severity=sev3. pages=3. Current state: mitigated (traffic gated).
